name: mmDoppler
description: A public mmWave radar dataset containing seven subjects performing 19 macro- and micro-scale human activities, with range-Doppler heatmaps and point-cloud measurements, including single- and multi-subject recordings.
citation: Sen, A., Das, A., Pradhan, S., & Chakraborty, S. (2024). A Dataset for Multi-intensity Continuous Human Activity Recognition through Passive Sensing. arXiv:2407.21125. https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.21125

license.notes: Repository identifies the dataset and code with GPL-3.0.
